title: The Grain Offering

questions.question: What was the main ingredient of the grain offering?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 2:1 (ESV): "When anyone brings a grain offering as an offering to the Lord, his offering shall be of fine flour."

questions.question: What was poured on the fine flour?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 2:1 (ESV): "He shall pour oil on it and put frankincense on it."

questions.question: What two ingredients were forbidden in grain offerings burned on the altar?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 2:11 (ESV): "No grain offering that you bring to the Lord shall be made with leaven, for you shall burn no leaven nor any honey."

questions.question: What seasoning must be included with every grain offering?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 2:13 (ESV): "You shall season all your grain offerings with salt."

questions.question: Who received the remainder of the grain offering after the memorial portion was burned?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 2:3 (ESV): "The rest of the grain offering shall be for Aaron and his sons."

questions.question: What was the memorial portion burned on the altar?
options: A handful of flour with oil and all the frankincense
questions.correctAnswer: A handful of flour with oil and all the frankincense
questions.explanation: Leviticus 2:2 (ESV): "He shall take from it a handful of the fine flour and oil, with all of its frankincense... as its memorial portion."

questions.question: What was the grain offering described as?
options: A most holy part of the food offerings
questions.correctAnswer: A most holy part of the food offerings
questions.explanation: Leviticus 2:3 (ESV): "It is a most holy part of the Lord's food offerings."

questions.question: If the grain offering was baked in an oven, what forms could it take?
options: Unleavened loaves mixed with oil or unleavened wafers
questions.correctAnswer: Unleavened loaves mixed with oil or unleavened wafers
questions.explanation: Leviticus 2:4 (ESV): "Unleavened loaves of fine flour mixed with oil, or unleavened wafers smeared with oil."

questions.question: What was a grain offering cooked on a griddle made of?
options: Fine flour unleavened, mixed with oil
questions.correctAnswer: Fine flour unleavened, mixed with oil
questions.explanation: Leviticus 2:5 (ESV): "Your offering is a grain offering baked on the griddle, it shall be of fine flour unleavened, mixed with oil."

questions.question: What was the salt of the grain offering called?
options: The salt of the covenant with your God
questions.correctAnswer: The salt of the covenant with your God
questions.explanation: Leviticus 2:13 (ESV): "You shall not let the salt of the covenant with your God be missing from your grain offering."

questions.question: What was the offering of firstfruits made of?
options: Fresh ears of grain, roasted with fire, crushed new grain
questions.correctAnswer: Fresh ears of grain, roasted with fire, crushed new grain
questions.explanation: Leviticus 2:14 (ESV): "If you offer a grain offering of firstfruits... you shall offer for the grain offering of your firstfruits fresh ears, roasted with fire, crushed new grain."

questions.question: Could leaven and honey be brought as an offering of firstfruits?
options: Yes, but they shall not be burned on the altar
questions.correctAnswer: Yes, but they shall not be burned on the altar
questions.explanation: Leviticus 2:12 (ESV): "As an offering of firstfruits you may bring them to the Lord, but they shall not be offered on the altar for a pleasing aroma."

questions.question: What was added to the firstfruits grain offering?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 2:15 (ESV): "And you shall put oil on it and lay frankincense on it; it is a grain offering."

questions.question: What cooking method was also mentioned for the grain offering besides oven and griddle?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 2:7 (ESV): "If your offering is a grain offering cooked in a pan, it shall be made of fine flour with oil."

questions.question: What was done to the griddle grain offering before being brought to the priest?
options: Broken in pieces and oil poured on it
questions.correctAnswer: Broken in pieces and oil poured on it
questions.explanation: Leviticus 2:6 (ESV): "You shall break it in pieces and pour oil on it; it is a grain offering."

key_verse_text: You shall season all your grain offerings with salt. You shall not let the salt of the covenant with your God be missing from your grain offering; with all your offerings you shall offer salt.
